description: Remove unrestricted developer cheats from the player-facing Info / Cargo overlay while preserving an explicit, opt-in development-only path for local debugging.
steps: Use and consult miner-daily-task-runner before implementing; run ./init.sh before development and preserve gameplay startup, Info / Cargo tab keyboard behavior, save/load, shop, and multiplayer hooks.

Audit src/ui.tsx, src/info-navigation.ts, src/game.ts, src/dom.ts, src/developer.ts, and their tests to identify every player-facing Developer tab/control and its event binding. Establish an intentional development-only activation mechanism appropriate for Vite (for example an explicit dev flag) rather than relying on obscurity.

Ensure normal production and default local play omit the Developer tab and all cash, service, upgrade, player-reset, and shared-world-reset cheat controls from the Info / Cargo navigation and tab order. Keep the existing player guidance tabs reachable with correct ARIA selection, close/focus restoration, and no dangling DOM lookups.
If an opt-in development mode is retained, make it visibly marked as non-player tooling and test its enabled and disabled shell/runtime behavior without exposing it by default.

Add focused DOM-free and React/runtime regression tests for the normal-player absence of cheats, the remaining tablist relationships and keyboard navigation, and any explicit development-mode gate. Use ./init.sh for desktop and 390×844 CDP smokes that start a solo run, move/mines, open/close Info / Cargo, traverse normal tabs, confirm no Developer/cheat text is exposed, and collect runtime exceptions.
acceptance: A normal player opening Info / Cargo never sees a Developer tab, money cheat, free service/upgrade controls, player-data reset, or shared-world reset action; the regular Objective & Cargo, Stats, Prospecting, Hazards, and Controls guidance remains usable.

The normal Info / Cargo tablist has correct ARIA relationships, keyboard navigation, modal close/focus restoration, and no runtime error from removed DOM hooks; an intentional opt-in development mode, if provided, is clearly isolated and covered by tests.

Updated tests pass and desktop/mobile browser smokes report no runtime exceptions. Before marking complete, follow miner-daily-task-runner and run ./init.sh, ./test.sh, npm test, npm run typecheck, and npm run build as fresh final verification.
